review.summary: Re-solved all 25 (5-choice, 90-min). Verified by hand: Q4 (84), Q9 (both trapezoids 22/26 valid → E), Q11 (12), Q13 (548+588+888=2024 → 37), Q17 (97541), Q18 (7423), Q21 (1661+363, diff 1298), Q22 (221133), Q23 (6070). Two real defects (Q16 stem typo, Q25 inconsistent worked grid) + figure nits.

findings.note: Box-layout typo: the stem says '□□ ÷ □□' (2-digit ÷ 2-digit), but the keyed answer 234 = 936 ÷ 4 needs '□□□ ÷ □' (3-digit ÷ 1-digit). A 2÷2 expression can't reach 234. Fix the box layout in body_en/body_id to □□□ ÷ □.

The hint's worked solution grid (873169542 / 624835179 / 189742356) does NOT satisfy the stated column sums: columns 3 and 4 are given as 14 and 18, but the grid yields 16 and 16 there (cols 1,2,5–9 do match, and the totals agree at 135). So the worked grid is wrong or the sums 14/18 are mis-transcribed. The marked cells (●=7, ◆=8, ★=5 → 10) may still be right, but re-solve against the real figure to reconcile.

Button-panel min-steps = 6 — per the visual index the scan captured only the button-rule chart, NOT the start/target figures, so the answer rests on a reconstruction of the start/target. Verify those against the original PDF.

Answer 7 = 8 valid sets − 1 named example. The 8 sets the hint lists all check out (2×middle = sum of the other two, all six digits used), but I did not exhaustively re-prove the enumeration is complete this pass.
Rabbit jump-over-stones path (E,F,H,G,B,A,C,D → ACEG=6714) depends on the reconstructed stone layout; route uniqueness not re-derived against the scan.

questions.body_en: A ship marked 038 is passing under a 156 m long bridge. Find the width of the ship in meters using the figure.
questions.body_id: Sebuah kapal bertanda 038 sedang melintas di bawah jembatan sepanjang 156 m. Tentukan lebar kapal dalam meter menggunakan gambar.
hint_steps_en: The bridge deck is split into 12 equal segments, so each is 156 ÷ 12 = 13 m.
The ship sits between the two dotted lines, spanning 3 of those segments.
Width = 3 × 13 = 39 m, choose B.
hint_steps_id: Lantai jembatan dibagi menjadi 12 ruas sama, jadi tiap ruas 156 ÷ 12 = 13 m.
Kapal berada di antara dua garis putus-putus, menutupi 3 ruas tersebut.
Lebar = 3 × 13 = 39 m, pilih B.

questions.body_en: The blackboard is in the east of the classroom. Teacher Sandra faces the students, and the blackboard is behind her. What direction is her left?
questions.body_id: Papan tulis berada di sebelah timur kelas. Guru Sandra menghadap para siswa, dan papan tulis ada di belakangnya. Ke arah mana sebelah kirinya?
hint_steps_en: The blackboard is east, and it is behind the teacher.
So the teacher faces the opposite of east, she faces west.
Standing facing west, the left hand points south.
Her left is south, choose B.
hint_steps_id: Papan tulis di timur, dan ada di belakang guru.
Jadi guru menghadap kebalikan timur, ia menghadap barat.
Berdiri menghadap barat, tangan kiri menunjuk ke selatan.
Sebelah kirinya selatan, pilih B.

questions.body_en: As shown, three people Amy, Ben, and Carol run an 800 m race. Ben is 596 m from the starting point, Carol is 144 m from the finish line. If the distance that Amy runs ahead of Carol equals the distance that Carol runs ahead of Ben, find the distance between Amy and the finish line in meters.
questions.body_id: Seperti pada gambar, tiga orang Amy, Ben, dan Carol berlari dalam lomba 800 m. Ben berjarak 596 m dari titik start, Carol berjarak 144 m dari garis finish. Jika jarak yang ditempuh Amy di depan Carol sama dengan jarak yang ditempuh Carol di depan Ben, tentukan jarak antara Amy dan garis finish dalam meter.
hint_steps_en: Ben is 596 m from start, so Ben is 800 − 596 = 204 m from the finish.
Carol is 144 m from the finish, so Carol is ahead of Ben by 204 − 144 = 60 m.
Amy is ahead of Carol by the SAME 60 m, so Amy is 144 − 60 = 84 m from the finish, choose D.
hint_steps_id: Ben 596 m dari start, jadi Ben 800 − 596 = 204 m dari finish.
Carol 144 m dari finish, jadi Carol di depan Ben sejauh 204 − 144 = 60 m.
Amy di depan Carol sejauh 60 m yang SAMA, jadi Amy 144 − 60 = 84 m dari finish, pilih D.

trap.why_id: Mengurangi selisih 60 m dua kali (atau mencampur jarak start dan finish) memberi 72; selisih hanya dikurangi sekali, jadi 84.

questions.body_en: 312 students need to go to the campsite for summer camp. The large buses will be filled with students first, and the rest will take the small buses. A large bus holds 45 students, and a small bus holds 7 students. If there are 6 large buses, how many small buses are needed at least?
questions.body_id: 312 siswa perlu pergi ke tempat perkemahan untuk kemah musim panas. Bus besar akan diisi terlebih dahulu, dan sisanya naik bus kecil. Satu bus besar menampung 45 siswa, dan satu bus kecil menampung 7 siswa. Jika ada 6 bus besar, paling sedikit berapa bus kecil yang diperlukan?
hint_steps_en: Fill the large buses first: 6 × 45 = 270 students seated.
Students left for small buses: 312 − 270 = 42.
Each small bus holds 7: 42 ÷ 7 = 6, no remainder.
6 small buses are needed, choose A.
hint_steps_id: Isi bus besar dulu: 6 × 45 = 270 siswa.
Siswa tersisa untuk bus kecil: 312 − 270 = 42.
Tiap bus kecil menampung 7: 42 ÷ 7 = 6, tanpa sisa.
Diperlukan 6 bus kecil, pilih A.

strategy.name_id: Isi bus besar, kurangi, lalu bagi sisanya dengan 7

questions.body_en: Two rectangles are joined seamlessly to form a composite figure. The composite figure has dimensions 30 cm, 10 cm, 22 cm, and 50 cm as labelled. If its perimeter is 168 cm, find ★.
questions.body_id: Dua persegi panjang digabung tanpa celah membentuk bangun gabungan. Bangun gabungan tersebut memiliki ukuran 30 cm, 10 cm, 22 cm, dan 50 cm sesuai label. Jika kelilingnya 168 cm, tentukan ★.
hint_steps_en: The shape is a small rectangle (top, 30 cm wide, ★ tall) sitting on a big one (bottom, 50 cm wide, 22 cm tall).
Each side ledge sticks out (50 − 30) ÷ 2 = 10 cm, which is the 10 cm label.
Add the fixed edges: 50 + 22 + 22 + 30 + 10 + 10 = 144 cm.
Perimeter 168 leaves 168 − 144 = 24 for the two ★ sides, so ★ = 24 ÷ 2 = 12, choose D.
hint_steps_id: Bangun ini persegi panjang kecil (atas, lebar 30 cm, tinggi ★) di atas yang besar (bawah, lebar 50 cm, tinggi 22 cm).
Tiap tepi samping menonjol (50 − 30) ÷ 2 = 10 cm, itulah label 10 cm.
Jumlahkan tepi tetap: 50 + 22 + 22 + 30 + 10 + 10 = 144 cm.
Keliling 168 menyisakan 168 − 144 = 24 untuk dua sisi ★, jadi ★ = 24 ÷ 2 = 12, pilih D.

highlights.phrase_en: 30 cm, 10 cm, 22 cm, and 50 cm
highlights.note_en: The four labelled edges.

highlights.phrase_en: Two rectangles are joined seamlessly
highlights.phrase_id: Dua persegi panjang digabung tanpa celah
highlights.note_en: No gap, so the edges meet exactly.

highlights.phrase_en: its perimeter is 168 cm
highlights.note_en: All outside edges add to 168.

highlights.phrase_en: find ★
highlights.note_en: ★ is the top rectangle missing side.
highlights.note_id: ★ adalah sisi atas yang belum diketahui.

strategy.name_en: Add every edge you know, subtract from the perimeter, split the rest between the two ★ sides
strategy.name_id: Jumlahkan tepi yang diketahui, kurangi dari keliling, bagi sisanya untuk dua sisi ★

trap.why_en: Counting ★ only once (168 − 154 = 14) forgets that the top rectangle has TWO vertical ★ sides.
trap.why_id: Menghitung ★ sekali saja (168 − 154 = 14) lupa bahwa persegi panjang atas punya DUA sisi tegak ★.

questions.body_en: A smoking cessation center warns the public that smoking one cigarette shortens life by 5 minutes on average. If a person smokes 204 cigarettes in a month, how many hours will his life be shortened?
questions.body_id: Sebuah pusat berhenti merokok memperingatkan masyarakat bahwa merokok satu batang rokok rata-rata mempersingkat hidup sebesar 5 menit. Jika seseorang merokok 204 batang dalam sebulan, berapa jam hidupnya akan diperpendek?
hint_steps_en: Minutes lost: 204 cigarettes × 5 minutes = 1020 minutes.
Change to hours: 1020 ÷ 60 = 17.
His life is shortened by 17 hours, choose A.
hint_steps_id: Menit yang hilang: 204 batang × 5 menit = 1020 menit.
Ubah ke jam: 1020 ÷ 60 = 17.
Hidupnya diperpendek 17 jam, pilih A.

questions.body_en: The sides of each small square is 1 cm. A composite figure has perimeter ◇ cm and area △ cm². In which option is ◇ exactly 2 times △? (See the five figure options.)
questions.body_id: Sisi setiap persegi kecil adalah 1 cm. Sebuah bangun gabungan memiliki keliling ◇ cm dan luas △ cm². Pada pilihan mana ◇ tepat sama dengan 2 kali △? (Lihat lima gambar pilihan.)
hint_steps_en: For each option, count the area △ (number of unit squares) and the perimeter ◇ (border length).
We need ◇ to be exactly 2 × △.
A 2 by 2 block has area 4 and perimeter 8, and 8 = 2 × 4, which is option C.
Only C satisfies ◇ = 2△, choose C.
hint_steps_id: Untuk tiap pilihan, hitung luas △ (banyak persegi satuan) dan keliling ◇ (panjang tepi).
Kita butuh ◇ tepat 2 × △.
Blok 2 kali 2 punya luas 4 dan keliling 8, dan 8 = 2 × 4, itulah pilihan C.
Hanya C yang memenuhi ◇ = 2△, pilih C.

highlights.phrase_en: sides of each small square is 1 cm
highlights.phrase_id: Sisi setiap persegi kecil adalah 1 cm
highlights.note_en: Each little square is 1 by 1.

highlights.phrase_en: ◇ exactly 2 times △
highlights.note_en: Perimeter must equal twice the area.

highlights.phrase_en: In which option
highlights.note_en: Pick the figure that fits the rule.

strategy.name_en: Count area and perimeter of each figure, keep the one where perimeter = 2 × area

questions.body_en: Given four identical right triangles with sides of 3 cm, 4 cm, and 5 cm. Use these four triangles to form a trapezoid. Find the perimeter of this trapezoid in cm.
questions.body_id: Diberikan empat segitiga siku-siku identik dengan sisi 3 cm, 4 cm, dan 5 cm. Gunakan keempat segitiga tersebut untuk membentuk sebuah trapesium. Tentukan keliling trapesium itu dalam cm.
hint_steps_en: The four 3-4-5 triangles always give the same total area: 4 × (3×4÷2) = 24 cm².
One trapezoid uses bases 3 and 9 with legs 5 and 5 (height 4): perimeter 3 + 9 + 5 + 5 = 22.
Another uses bases 4 and 12 with legs 5 and 5 (height 3): perimeter 4 + 12 + 5 + 5 = 26.
Both are real trapezoids, so the perimeter is 22 or 26, choose E.
hint_steps_id: Empat segitiga 3-4-5 selalu memberi luas total sama: 4 × (3×4÷2) = 24 cm².
Satu trapesium memakai alas 3 dan 9 dengan kaki 5 dan 5 (tinggi 4): keliling 3 + 9 + 5 + 5 = 22.
Trapesium lain memakai alas 4 dan 12 dengan kaki 5 dan 5 (tinggi 3): keliling 4 + 12 + 5 + 5 = 26.
Keduanya trapesium sah, jadi kelilingnya 22 atau 26, pilih E.

highlights.phrase_en: four identical right triangles with sides of 3 cm, 4 cm, and 5 cm
highlights.phrase_id: empat segitiga siku-siku identik dengan sisi 3 cm, 4 cm, dan 5 cm
highlights.note_en: Each piece is a 3-4-5 right triangle.

highlights.phrase_en: Use these four triangles to form a trapezoid
highlights.phrase_id: Gunakan keempat segitiga tersebut untuk membentuk sebuah trapesium
highlights.note_en: All four must fit into one trapezoid.

highlights.phrase_en: Find the perimeter of this trapezoid in cm
highlights.phrase_id: Tentukan keliling trapesium itu dalam cm
highlights.note_en: Add the outside edges of the trapezoid.

strategy.name_en: Keep the total area at 24, then try the trapezoids the pieces can actually form
strategy.name_id: Jaga luas total 24, lalu coba trapesium yang bisa dibentuk potongan

trap.why_en: 24 is the total AREA of the four triangles, not a perimeter; the two real trapezoids measure 22 and 26 around the edge.
trap.why_id: 24 adalah LUAS total empat segitiga, bukan keliling; dua trapesium sebenarnya berkeliling 22 dan 26.

Tall box becomes a rectangle; ball becomes a circle; small cube becomes a square; triangular prism becomes a triangle.

Kotak tinggi jadi persegi panjang; bola jadi lingkaran; kubus kecil jadi persegi; prisma segitiga jadi segitiga.
Tampak atas yang menampilkan tepat keempat bentuk itu di tempatnya adalah pilihan D, pilih D.

questions.body_en: A Chinese restaurant value meal includes 1 entrée and 2 sides. The entrées are Rice and Dumpling; the sides are Chicken, Shrimp, Beef, and Tofu. How many different combinations can Lee make?
questions.body_id: Paket makan siang restoran Chinese mencakup 1 hidangan utama dan 2 lauk. Hidangan utamanya adalah Nasi dan Pangsit; lauknya adalah Ayam, Udang, Sapi, dan Tahu. Berapa banyak kombinasi berbeda yang bisa dipilih Lee?
hint_steps_en: Choose the entrée: 2 ways (Rice or Dumpling).
Choose 2 sides out of 4: Chicken-Shrimp, Chicken-Beef, Chicken-Tofu, Shrimp-Beef, Shrimp-Tofu, Beef-Tofu = 6 ways.
Multiply: 2 × 6 = 12 combinations, choose C.
hint_steps_id: Pilih hidangan utama: 2 cara (Nasi atau Pangsit).
Pilih 2 lauk dari 4: Ayam-Udang, Ayam-Sapi, Ayam-Tahu, Udang-Sapi, Udang-Tahu, Sapi-Tahu = 6 cara.
Kalikan: 2 × 6 = 12 kombinasi, pilih C.

trap.why_id: 2 utama × 4 lauk = 8 hanya satu lauk; paket butuh DUA lauk, jadi 6 pasang dan 12 paket.

questions.body_en: 2 of the 9 small triangles are already painted to make a line-symmetry figure. If 2 more triangles are painted with the same color, how many ways are there to paint so that the figure remains a line-symmetry figure?
questions.body_id: 2 dari 9 segitiga kecil telah dicat untuk membuat bangun simetri garis. Jika 2 segitiga lagi dicat dengan warna yang sama, ada berapa cara pengecatan agar bangun tetap simetri garis?
hint_steps_en: The big triangle has 9 small ones and 3 lines of symmetry (one through each corner).
The 2 painted triangles stay matched if the 2 new ones complete a mirror pair across one axis.
Checking all 3 axes, the valid extra pairs are AC, AG, CG, EG, EI, FG, FH, GH, GI.
That is 9 ways, choose C.
hint_steps_id: Segitiga besar punya 9 segitiga kecil dan 3 sumbu simetri (satu lewat tiap sudut).
2 segitiga tercat tetap simetri jika 2 yang baru melengkapi pasangan cermin terhadap salah satu sumbu.
Memeriksa ketiga sumbu, pasangan tambahan yang sah: AC, AG, CG, EG, EI, FG, FH, GH, GI.
Itu 9 cara, pilih C.

highlights.note_en: Two triangles start coloured.

highlights.note_en: Add exactly two more of the same colour.

trap.why_id: Hanya memeriksa sumbu tegak memberi 5 pasang; dua sumbu lain menambah 4, jadi 9.

questions.body_en: If the same shape represents the same digit, find □ + ○ × △. The column addition is: □○△ + □△△ + △△△ = 2024.
questions.body_id: Jika bentuk yang sama mewakili angka yang sama, tentukan □ + ○ × △. Penjumlahan berkolom: □○△ + □△△ + △△△ = 2024.
hint_steps_en: Units column: △ + △ + △ = 3△ must end in 4 (because 2024 ends in 4); 3 × 8 = 24, so △ = 8, write 4 carry 2.
Now □○8 + □88 + 888 = 2024, so □○8 + □88 = 1136; the two □ hundreds force □ = 5.
hint_steps_id: Kolom satuan: △ + △ + △ = 3△ harus berakhir 4 (karena 2024 berakhir 4); 3 × 8 = 24, jadi △ = 8, tulis 4 simpan 2.
Sekarang □○8 + □88 + 888 = 2024, jadi □○8 + □88 = 1136; dua ratusan □ memaksa □ = 5.

highlights.phrase_en: the same shape represents the same digit
highlights.phrase_id: bentuk yang sama mewakili angka yang sama
highlights.note_en: Equal shapes are equal digits.
The column sum to solve.

highlights.phrase_en: find □ + ○ × △
highlights.note_en: Combine the three digits with this rule.
highlights.note_id: Gabungkan ketiga angka dengan aturan ini.

strategy.name_en: Solve the units column first, then carry upward to fix each digit
strategy.name_id: Pecahkan kolom satuan dulu, lalu naik dengan simpanan untuk tiap angka

trap.why_en: Reading it as (□ + ○) × △ = 9 × 8 = 72, or adding all three, is wrong; multiply ○ × △ first, then add □, giving 37.
trap.why_id: Membaca (□ + ○) × △ = 9 × 8 = 72 atau menjumlah ketiganya salah; kalikan ○ × △ dulu, lalu tambah □, jadi 37.

questions.body_en: Given 7 dice and an unfolded net of a die (as shown). How many of the 7 dice at most can have the same unfolded view as shown?
questions.body_id: Diberikan 7 buah dadu dan jaring-jaring sebuah dadu (seperti gambar). Berapa banyak dari 7 dadu tersebut yang paling banyak dapat memiliki jaring-jaring yang sama seperti gambar?
hint_steps_en: The net fixes which faces sit opposite each other when it is folded into a die.
Folding can give two mirror versions of the cube; a die matches only if its face pattern and turning agree with the net.
Comparing each of the 7 dice with the folded net, the matching ones share the right faces and the right turn.
At most 4 of the 7 dice can match the shown unfolded view, choose B.

questions.body_en: Four number cards are arranged left to right in a fixed order. Different arithmetic signs give different equations: □ + □□ + □ = 52; □ + □□ − □ = 46; □ + □□□ = 430. Find the 4-digit number formed by the four cards from left to right.
questions.body_id: Empat kartu angka disusun dari kiri ke kanan dengan urutan tetap. Tanda aritmetika berbeda menghasilkan persamaan berbeda: □ + □□ + □ = 52; □ + □□ − □ = 46; □ + □□□ = 430. Tentukan bilangan 4 angka yang dibentuk dari keempat kartu dari kiri ke kanan.
hint_steps_en: Call the cards a, b, c, d left to right. The first two equations: a + bc + d = 52 and a + bc − d = 46.
Add them: 2a + 2(bc) = 98, so a + bc = 49; subtract them: 2d = 6, so d = 3.
The third equation a + bcd = 430 with d = 3 gives bcd = 423, so b = 4, c = 2; then a = 49 − 42 = 7.
Left to right the cards are 7, 4, 2, 3, the number 7423.
hint_steps_id: Sebut kartu a, b, c, d dari kiri ke kanan. Dua persamaan pertama: a + bc + d = 52 dan a + bc − d = 46.
Jumlahkan: 2a + 2(bc) = 98, jadi a + bc = 49; kurangkan: 2d = 6, jadi d = 3.
Persamaan ketiga a + bcd = 430 dengan d = 3 memberi bcd = 423, jadi b = 4, c = 2; lalu a = 49 − 42 = 7.
Dari kiri ke kanan kartunya 7, 4, 2, 3, bilangannya 7423.

questions.body_en: Some natural numbers read the same from left to right and from right to left; such numbers are called palindrome numbers, like 212 and 5885. If the sum of two palindrome numbers is 2024, find the smallest possible difference between these two palindrome numbers.
questions.body_id: Beberapa bilangan asli terbaca sama dari kiri ke kanan dan dari kanan ke kiri; bilangan seperti ini disebut bilangan palindrom, seperti 212 dan 5885. Jika jumlah dua bilangan palindrom adalah 2024, tentukan selisih terkecil yang mungkin antara kedua bilangan palindrom tersebut.
hint_steps_en: The two palindrome numbers add to 2024, and we want their difference as small as possible.
Small difference means both numbers are near half of 2024, which is 1012.
Test palindromes near 1012: 1661 is a palindrome and 2024 − 1661 = 363, which is also a palindrome.
Their difference is 1661 − 363 = 1298, the smallest possible.
hint_steps_id: Kedua bilangan palindrom berjumlah 2024, dan kita ingin selisihnya sekecil mungkin.
Selisih kecil berarti kedua bilangan dekat dengan setengah dari 2024, yaitu 1012.
Uji palindrom dekat 1012: 1661 palindrom dan 2024 − 1661 = 363, yang juga palindrom.
Selisihnya 1661 − 363 = 1298, yang terkecil mungkin.

questions.body_en: Six number cards 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3 are placed face-down behind six cards labelled A, B, C, D, E, F. Ava, Bella, Cindy, and Donna each pick two cards and turn them over. The person who picks the same two numbers wins. Given: Ava picks A→2 and E→3 (Lose); Bella picks A and C (Lose); Cindy picks A and F (Lose); Donna picks C and D (Win). Find the 6-digit number ABCDEF.
questions.body_id: Enam kartu angka 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3 diletakkan terbalik di belakang enam kartu berlabel A, B, C, D, E, F. Ava, Bella, Cindy, dan Donna masing-masing mengambil dua kartu dan membaliknya. Orang yang mengambil dua angka yang sama menang. Diketahui: Ava mengambil A→2 dan E→3 (Kalah); Bella mengambil A dan C (Kalah); Cindy mengambil A dan F (Kalah); Donna mengambil C dan D (Menang). Tentukan bilangan 6 angka ABCDEF.
hint_steps_en: Ava turned A = 2 and E = 3, so A is the digit 2 and E is the digit 3.
Donna won with C and D, so C = D; Bella lost with A and C means C is not 2, so the equal pair C = D must be the two 1s, giving C = D = 1.
The remaining digits 2 and 3 go to B and F; Cindy lost with A and F means F is not 2, so F = 3 and B = 2.
So A=2, B=2, C=1, D=1, E=3, F=3, the number ABCDEF = 221133.
hint_steps_id: Ava membalik A = 2 dan E = 3, jadi A adalah angka 2 dan E adalah angka 3.
Donna menang dengan C dan D, jadi C = D; Bella kalah dengan A dan C berarti C bukan 2, jadi pasangan sama C = D pastilah dua angka 1, memberi C = D = 1.
Sisa angka 2 dan 3 untuk B dan F; Cindy kalah dengan A dan F berarti F bukan 2, jadi F = 3 dan B = 2.
Jadi A=2, B=2, C=1, D=1, E=3, F=3, bilangan ABCDEF = 221133.

questions.body_en: Cut Picture 1 to obtain Picture 2 (4 squares). Cut one square in Picture 2 to obtain Picture 3 (7 squares). Each time one square is cut into 4 smaller squares. Following this pattern, how many squares does Picture 2024 have?
questions.body_id: Potong Gambar 1 untuk mendapatkan Gambar 2 (4 persegi). Potong satu persegi pada Gambar 2 untuk mendapatkan Gambar 3 (7 persegi). Setiap kali satu persegi dipotong menjadi 4 persegi lebih kecil. Mengikuti pola ini, berapa banyak persegi yang dimiliki Gambar 2024?
hint_steps_en: Picture 1 has 1 square, Picture 2 has 4, Picture 3 has 7.
Each step cuts one square into 4, so it removes 1 and adds 4, a net gain of 3 squares.
So Picture n has 1 + 3 × (n − 1) squares.
Picture 2024 has 1 + 3 × 2023 = 1 + 6069 = 6070 squares.
hint_steps_id: Gambar 1 punya 1 persegi, Gambar 2 punya 4, Gambar 3 punya 7.
Tiap langkah memotong satu persegi menjadi 4, jadi menghapus 1 dan menambah 4, untung bersih 3 persegi.
Jadi Gambar ke-n punya 1 + 3 × (n − 1) persegi.
Gambar 2024 punya 1 + 3 × 2023 = 1 + 6069 = 6070 persegi.

questions.body_en: Help the rabbit find the carrot. The rabbit can only skip forward through a stone vertically, horizontally, or diagonally. It cannot skip without a stone and cannot pass through the same stone twice. The rabbit must pass through all the stones. The grid shows stones labelled A–H and the rabbit's start. Find the 4-digit number ACEG corresponding to the order in which A, C, E, and G are visited.
questions.body_id: Bantu kelinci menemukan wortel. Kelinci hanya dapat melompat maju melalui batu secara vertikal, horizontal, atau diagonal. Ia tidak dapat melompat tanpa batu dan tidak boleh melewati batu yang sama dua kali. Kelinci harus melewati semua batu. Kisi menunjukkan batu berlabel A–H dan posisi awal kelinci. Tentukan bilangan 4 angka ACEG sesuai urutan kunjungan A, C, E, dan G.
hint_steps_en: The rabbit must jump over every stone exactly once, in a straight line each jump, and finish at the carrot.
Starting at the bottom-left, the only path that uses all 8 stones is E, F, H, G, B, A, C, D, ending at the carrot.
So the visit order is A=6th, C=7th, E=1st, G=4th.
Reading A, C, E, G gives the number ACEG = 6714.
hint_steps_id: Kelinci harus melompati setiap batu tepat sekali, tiap lompatan lurus, dan berakhir di wortel.
Mulai dari kiri bawah, satu-satunya jalur yang memakai semua 8 batu adalah E, F, H, G, B, A, C, D, berakhir di wortel.
Jadi urutan kunjungan A=ke-6, C=ke-7, E=ke-1, G=ke-4.
Membaca A, C, E, G memberi bilangan ACEG = 6714.

questions.body_en: Fill numbers 1–9 in the squares so that each row contains each number 1–9 exactly once. Each number in a circle below a column is the sum of the three numbers in the squares directly above it, and the three numbers in each column are all different (for example, the last column: 2 + 9 + 6 = 17). The partially filled grid (blank = _) is: Row 1: _, ●, 3, _, 6, 9, _, 4, 2; Row 2: 6, _, 4, ◆, _, _, 1, _, 9; Row 3: _, 8, _, 9, 4, _, _, ★, 6; circle sums: 15, 17, 14, 18, 13, 16, 9, 16, 17. Find ● + ◆ − ★.
questions.body_id: Isikan angka 1–9 ke dalam kotak sehingga setiap baris memuat masing-masing angka 1–9 tepat sekali. Setiap angka dalam lingkaran di bawah sebuah kolom adalah jumlah tiga angka di kotak tepat di atasnya, dan tiga angka dalam setiap kolom semuanya berbeda (misalnya, kolom terakhir: 2 + 9 + 6 = 17). Kisi yang sebagian terisi (kosong = _) adalah: Baris 1: _, ●, 3, _, 6, 9, _, 4, 2; Baris 2: 6, _, 4, ◆, _, _, 1, _, 9; Baris 3: _, 8, _, 9, 4, _, _, ★, 6; jumlah lingkaran: 15, 17, 14, 18, 13, 16, 9, 16, 17. Tentukan ● + ◆ − ★.
hint_steps_en: Each row uses 1 to 9 once, and each circle is the sum of the three boxes above it.
Start from tight columns: column 7 sums to 9 with a 1 fixed, and column 1 sums to 15 with a 6 fixed; the all-different rule and the row 1–9 rule fill the gaps column by column.
The unique completed rows are 8 7 3 1 6 9 5 4 2 / 6 2 4 8 3 5 1 7 9 / 1 8 7 9 4 2 3 5 6.
hint_steps_id: Tiap baris memakai 1 sampai 9 sekali, dan tiap lingkaran adalah jumlah tiga kotak di atasnya.

Mulai dari kolom yang ketat: kolom 7 berjumlah 9 dengan angka 1 sudah terisi, dan kolom 1 berjumlah 15 dengan angka 6 sudah terisi; aturan semua-berbeda dan aturan baris 1–9 mengisi celah kolom demi kolom.
Baris lengkap yang unik adalah 8 7 3 1 6 9 5 4 2 / 6 2 4 8 3 5 1 7 9 / 1 8 7 9 4 2 3 5 6.
